reason: Value lens: the expected private gain is about 0. (1) In the 'K2 shows 0.953' world, a scored K1 = 0.954 changes nothing under the pre-registered rules. R3 keeps lowrefine at -0.001, §f lets a simpler file replace F1 only at >= +0.002, and R7 forbids choosing between near-copies by 0.001. The claimed +0.001 exists only if the pre-registration is broken, to pick by a difference the LB rounds to 3 decimals. K1 and K2 differ only by lowrefine, which moves low-detection readmitted peaks (final nodes +0.004/+0.118/0/+0.013% per dummy clip), so the true gap can be ~0.0001, and its transfer to private embryos is noise. Slots S10-S11, S15-S16 and S18-S21 are free, which leaves 3 days of margin. Also, K1 shares every failure mode except fail-soft lowrefine (12 h limit, insertion, environment), so P(K2 error and K1 ok) is ~0.01. (3) The K1-vs-#35 attribution has about zero power. They are byte-identical unless x138's 7.5 h deadline fired, and step 0 bounds that to the last few of ~100 clips. That is <= ~0.0001 of the +0.001 insertion gain, invisible at 3-decimal rounding, so 'K1 > #35 -> raise DIVINS_DEADLINE_S' would be driven by rounding noise. (4) A second latency sample adds little, because K2's own latency is polled anyway and K1 runtime <= K2. Net: harmless and cheap (0.1 h, no quota, parallel rerun), but the idea gives certainty about 8 h earlier, not score, and it needs an amendment to the pre-registered §e for no private gain.
fix: Keep §e as written. If the user still wants K1 tonight for logistics, frame it as insurance only: no finals rule changes, no DIVINS_DEADLINE tuning from its score.
